description: Managed Retreat Toolkit is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Georgetown Climate Center. This resource presents legal and policy tools, best and emerging practices, and case studies to support peer learning and decision making around managed retreat and climate adaptation. The primary audiences for the toolkit are state, territorial, and local policymakers in U.S. coastal jurisdictions. Collectively, the toolkit is designed to help policymakers:. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Flooding – Coastal. Assets: Critical Facilities, Economy, Natural Areas and Wildlife, People, Property. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
